evals.name: activity-page-premium
evals.prompt: The Activity page (frontend/app/activity/page.tsx) feels plain and a bit cheap. Redesign it to feel premium and Apple-quality — better hierarchy, spacing, and typography. Keep the existing data and behavior.
evals.expected_output: Edited activity page that reads as more premium: clearer hierarchy, consistent spacing rhythm, refined rows, designed empty/loading states, one accent — all using the existing cp-* tokens (no new colors/gradients/heavy shadows). Brief rationale.

evals.name: profile-page-polish
evals.prompt: Polish the Profile page (frontend/app/profile/page.tsx) so it feels more refined and premium — tighten the layout, typography, and spacing. Don't change what it does.
evals.expected_output: Edited profile page with sharper type hierarchy, an 8pt spacing rhythm, hairline structure, calm single-accent color, proper states — consistent with the CirclePay design system. Brief rationale.
